issues.claim: T110-2 (2) (l. 19359-19362; S2 (1)) holds class (B)'s B2 (c) (§4.2 S3 (6), l. 6232: the cross wall not laid, the stage walled by its enceinte round the union) by a variant whose declared aqueduct is shape-locked and 'crosses the partition line with its channel within the cross wall's height wherever that line may be re-laid, the cross wall not laid … (§2.7's laws, law 1 (2), (10), law 2 (c))'. A channel within the wall's height gives the merged form (law 1 (2)). Law 1 (10)'s list (l. 2740-2743: 'a wall-like line, band or strip newly across the strip of a `vault`-use span of it, an aqueduct merged into it, a soffit lowered over a run of it, a gate made in it') bars an aqueduct merged into a shape-locked wall, not a wall merged round a shape-locked aqueduct. Part P pass 8 (PRB7H-LCK-01, adjudication-r7.md l. 3988) lists 'a wall merged round a shape-locked aqueduct's pier' among the meetings that apply. The merge is barred only where the band or wall strips would lie newly across a `vault`-use span's strip, and the fixture fixes no span's `use` (the span rule's (3) draws it, l. 3405-3407). So a correct build lays the cross wall merged on most seeds, and S0 makes the bar assert that. B2 (c) is then held by no bar, and this variant runs only once the shape lock exists. A build that sends the cross wall to F-WALL's raised-way rung keeps law 1 and passes every bar; that rung may unwall the stage, which r7y's P2 note ruled out (PRB7H-GEN-04 (i)). This is VF7x-TST-02's grade: a test gap whose wrong build keeps law 1.
issues.required_change: T110-2 (2) (l. 19359-19362): "and, from the milestone that carries the shape lock (J147, J150), on a variant whose declared aqueduct, shape-locked and running wholly inside the union, crosses the partition line with its channel within the cross wall's height wherever that line may be re-laid, the cross wall not laid, `W_RAISED_MEETING` reported and the stage walled by its enceinte round the union (§4.2 S3 (6); §2.7's laws, law 1 (2), (10), law 2 (c))" → "and, on a variant whose declared aqueduct, running wholly inside the union, crosses the partition line with its channel above the cross wall's top by less than the deck's depth (`raisedWays.structure.span.deckDepthCm`) wherever that line may be re-laid, so that §2.7's laws admit its crossing there in neither form (law 1 (2)), the cross wall not laid, `W_RAISED_MEETING` reported, F-WALL's raised-way rung not run and the stage walled by its enceinte round the union (§4.2 S3 (6); §2.7's laws, law 1 (2), law 2 (c))". This is the device T110-2 (1)'s low-channel aqueduct and (6)'s top-up run already use. It needs no lock, so it runs with T110-2 (2) at M3a; the shape-locked ring's law 1 (10) side stays with T110-4 (c)'s third run.

issues.claim: Four outcomes this pass wrote are run by no bar (VF7x-TST-02's class). For each, a build of the old reading keeps law 1 and passes every bar, giving way or waiting where the laws lay a lawful shape. (a) §4.2 S3 (6) (l. 6232; P2, B2): the cross wall's barred gate 'moved along the inter-nucleus route to the nearest place they admit it', else 'that route re-routed … to cross the cross wall where those laws admit its gate'. T110-2 (2)'s variants (l. 19352-19362) run only the line and (c). (b) §7.1 *Raised ways, aqueducts and retaining walls* (l. 11155-11159; D6) with V09 §4.20.2 (4) (V9-2): a raised road's barred ground-way gate '(a) … crossing of the wall moved to the nearest place they admit its gate, (b) else the way re-routed through the nearest gate of that wall a way of its class may pass, (c) else refused'. T110-2 (2)'s hand raised road (l. 19368-19371) and T-V9-52 run only the gate made where the way crosses; PRB7H-LCK-04 ruled the re-route-first reading out under item 101 R2, as the program reads it. (c) V07 §3.11's REPLACEMENT (V07 l. 2314-2318; V7-1): its new step '(b) else the ground ways, plots and unlocked buildings that shape meets moved as law 2 (b) moves them'. T-V7-48 runs only (a) and (c). (d) §4.4 S5d (l. 6728; P6, B7) at an epoch: the arc kept and 'at an epoch counted `walls.waited` besides'. S2 (3)'s top-up run is a regeneration's, and no bar runs the epoch branch. J146 and J151 narrow the family's majors to a law-1 invariant checked by no bar, so each item is minor.

V06 T-V6-47 (V06 l. 4220), before "after the METROPOLIS circuit ran on beneath the aqueduct," insert: "on an H-AQUA variant whose METROPOLIS epoch's new stage takes S5d's top-up, its seed searched so that the top-up's arc between two pinned gates must cross the aqueduct where its channel runs above the circuit's top by less than the deck's depth (`raisedWays.structure.span.deckDepthCm`) wherever that arc's search band meets it — that arc kept as it stood, its shortfall moved to the next stage's quota, reported and counted in `walls.waited`, the stage walled by the circuit and nothing else waiting (§4.4 S5d; §2.7's laws, law 2 (c)); ". Items 1 and 2 run at M3a, item 3 at V-M3 and item 4 at E3, each with its clause.

issues.claim: §5.2's F-SITE row (l. 9859) has the rung '→ merge the two under one enceinte with a cross wall, reported' and the test 'twin-town fixtures: walls apart by the floor, or one enceinte with a cross wall'. B2 (c) (§4.2 S3 (6), l. 6232; D3, l. 9992) gives one enceinte and no cross wall wherever §2.7's laws leave the cross wall no lawful shape. T110-2 (2)'s variants are twin-town fixtures, so once VF7y-TST-01's fixture holds B2 (c), this test fails a correct build there. S0 does not reach the test cell: it neither takes a T110 clause nor cites §2.7's laws. The grade is VF7x-RDR-01's (a case its fixtures may not hold), and the two fixes are to land together. Separately, F-BUDGET-STAGE's row (l. 9861) now carries D2's kept arc, but its test cell names only '§13.2's B-CITY `wealthLevel` sweep', which holds no raised way, and not T110-2 (6)'s top-up run (S2 (3)).
issues.required_change: §5.2: F-SITE's ladder cell "→ merge the two under one enceinte with a cross wall, reported" → "→ merge the two under one enceinte with a cross wall, save one §2.7's laws leave out for a raised way (§4.2 S3 (6); law 2 (c)), reported"; F-SITE's test cell "twin-town fixtures: walls apart by the floor, or one enceinte with a cross wall" → "twin-town fixtures: walls apart by the floor, or one enceinte with a cross wall, save one §2.7's laws leave out for a raised way, reported (`W_RAISED_MEETING`; §4.2 S3 (6); T110-2 (2))"; F-BUDGET-STAGE's test cell "§13.2's B-CITY `wealthLevel` sweep" → "§13.2's B-CITY `wealthLevel` sweep; T110-2 (6)'s top-up run (an arc §2.7's laws give no lawful shape against a standing raised way kept as it stood)".

issues.claim: T-V6-47's pin clause (V06 l. 4220; V6-1) reads 'on a second run with none there, the road re-routed through a lawful gate of the circuit … (§4.4 S5a *Trace* (2); §2.7's laws, law 2 (a), (b))'. H-AQUA's main approach road is its viaduct's carried way (V06 l. 4106-4108), and law 2 (b) re-routes a carried way as *Carried way* says: 'from the first point beyond the foot through the nearest gate of that wall that a way of its class may pass' (l. 2791-2793). T110-2 (6)'s third run writes the same case so (l. 19624). 'A lawful gate' passes a build that re-routes through a farther gate, or through a postern or a water gate. S0 makes the bar assert the laws' outcome, so the grade is minor.
issues.required_change: T-V6-47 (V06 l. 4220): "the road re-routed through a lawful gate of the circuit, the circuit laid with its gates on ground part 0, nothing waiting (§4.4 S5a *Trace* (2); §2.7's laws, law 2 (a), (b));" → "the road re-routed from the first point beyond the foot through the nearest gate of the circuit a way of its class may pass, the circuit laid with its gates on ground part 0, nothing waiting (§4.4 S5a *Trace* (2); §2.7's laws, law 2 (a), (b), *Carried way*);".

issues.claim: Row W12·C10 (l. 3357; a landfall over a run beneath a deck that `repairRaised` repaired) reads 'as W12·C2 · T114-3's landfall clause'. Its column is the raised way's state at the row's event (*Paths and tests*, l. 3324-3326; C10, l. 3295). V05's T-V5-14 runs that clause, and its list of 'the raised way's other states too, each on its own run of that fixture' (V05 l. 2568-2577) holds every state but a span repaired before the fall; the clause's own repair comes after the fall. Every other C10 cell of the table names a state-sweep run, which makes C10. A build that treats a repaired span apart from a standing one keeps law 1 and passes: R7-01's grading of a cell whose named test does not hold its case.
issues.required_change: V05 T-V5-14 (V05 l. 2573-2574): "and, on another, re-spaced by a hand edit of its `spanSpacingCm`;" → "and, on another, re-spaced by a hand edit of its `spanSpacingCm`; a span over the run `ruined` and repaired by `repairRaised` before the fall;".

held_notes.note: 'a road drawn across a viaduct crosses under its nearest `open` span' pins the span row (b) gives by §4.3's crossing rule. The meeting is a raised way with a ground way, with no wall (adjudication-r7y held item 12, persisting).
'crosses the hand-off up held' means carried unchanged, while §2.7's *held* now means locked. This is a rung hand-off, with no wall meeting (held item 13, persisting).

'that route re-solved to cross under the nearest span the rule admits' pins a place a route solve's own cost chooses. The meeting is a raised way with a ground way, with no wall (held item 14, persisting).

The cross wall's gate law names one gate only, 'with a gate where the inter-nucleus route crosses it'. Nothing says how the cross wall meets another way laid before it that crosses the partition line on the ground: a creation prefix's declared road, or a kept one. This is a wall with a ground way. A declared road deck's carried way so crossing reaches the family through *Carried way*'s 'its gate where the wall crosses that course beyond the foot'; no fixture of this lens holds it.
